name: Ozunu
source: A mysterious old man staying at the Haunted House Inn. He's a fixture in the Lower District where unsavory types assemble, and is the boss of the whole underworld of the city. He has a prickly personality, and for some reason heaps abuse upon Kuu whenever they meet. It seems like he and Euro know each other...
